meta.name: test-generation
meta.description: Generate comprehensive test suites for existing code. Use when asked to write tests, add test coverage, create unit tests, or build integration tests.

copy.tagline: 为已有代码自动生成测试套件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有代码需要补充测试覆盖
copy.tagline_en: Generate comprehensive test suites for existing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add test coverage to existing code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取你的代码，自动生成测试用例，包括正常路径、边界情况和错误处理。它会识别测试框架（pytest、vitest 或 jest），按 AAA 模式编写，并运行测试确保全部通过。
howto.when: 当你要求为现有代码编写测试、增加测试覆盖率、创建单元测试或集成测试时触发。它会检查项目中的测试配置文件（如 pytest.ini、vitest.config、jest.config）。

say.text: 给这个函数写单元测试
say.note: Claude 会读取该函数并生成测试

say.text: 为整个模块生成测试套件
say.note: Claude 会分析模块并生成完整测试

say.text: 帮我增加边缘情况测试
say.note: Claude 会针对边界值补充测试

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude reads your code and automatically generates test cases including happy path, edge cases, and error handling. It detects the test framework (pytest, vitest, or jest), writes tests using the AAA pattern, and runs them to confirm all pass.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write tests for existing code, add test coverage, create unit tests, or build integration tests. It checks for config files like pytest.ini, vitest.config, or jest.config.

say_en.text: Write unit tests for this function
say_en.note: Claude reads the function and generates tests

say_en.text: Generate a test suite for the whole module
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the module and produces full tests

say_en.text: Add edge case tests for me
